status: MODEL / planning result of the board_gen planner (standard library); no KiCad board, no routing, no hardware result; bench gates OPEN

fill.label: MODEL: courtyard boxes of the vendored KiCad 10.0.7 footprints (F.CrtYd), not a routed board
fill.f2_trigger: courtyard fill of PWR-A or PWR-B > 0.60 in placement, or unrouted nets after two placement iterations (PCB-PWRA-1/2, PCB-PWRB). The model already exceeds it: raw fill PWR-A 0.972, PWR-B 1.302 for (a)
f2_fired_why: fill of the placed subset alone > 0.60

F2a_pololu_off_board.what: Pololu D36V50F12/F5 on plate standoffs (option F2a (c))

F2b_pcb_rear.what: rear-tier board taking the F2b groups; their THT radials stay on PWR-A (F2b text)

bottom.use: battery circuit (Mini-Fit Jr., 18 AWG), BMS and IP2368 leads

right.use: blower, BMS, CTRL harness S02 (JST PH, Micro-Fit); bottom-row ports and GX16 through plate slot SL3

top_sl2.use: rear-layer harness through plate slot SL2 (S04, S13, S14, S17, S18, S20-S22, S35; JST PH, Micro-Fit)

pwr_b_cutouts.rule: pcb/partition-spec.json height_rule and keepouts: courtyard + window_margin for parts taller than hA and for the PWR-A headers; a probe window of tp_probe_window for a test point

tht_pads.rule: every PWR-A THT pad gets a plate relief pocket >= 1.0 mm and polyimide over the 0.4 mm gap (mechanical/params/boards.json tht_pockets); rows inside a thermal_bond zone also cut the Gelid pad

scripted_copper_precheck.label: geometry of the spec copper against the planned pads; KiCad fill, thermal spokes and neck widths are checked only on the routed board

boundary.note: nets with pins on other boards that end on no graph connector pin of PWR-A; the B2B is not a graph ref yet (GR-4), so its nets show as dangling here
